description: A single-panel figure consisting of Table 6, rendered as an image, which reports EDS-measured aluminium and manganese contents in the 9Al-10Mn-1C lightweight steel after tempering at 800 °C. The header row gives the unit "wt%" and splits the data into two blocks, Al and Mn; each block is subdivided into three phase columns labelled δ, γ and k. The three data rows are Min, Mean and Max of each measured population. For Al the values are δ 8.1/8.4/8.7, γ 6.8/7.4/8.7 and k 8.6/9.4/10.0 wt% (Min/Mean/Max). For Mn they are δ 7.4/8.3/9.1, γ 11.1/11.4/12.3 and k 10.1/12.3/13.8 wt%. The table shows Al is slightly enriched in the k phase (mean 9.4 wt%) and depleted in γ (mean 7.4 wt%), whereas Mn is strongly depleted in δ (mean 8.3 wt%) and enriched in γ (11.4 wt%) and k (12.3 wt%); the narrow Min-to-Max spreads (≤1.9 wt%) indicate limited scatter. No micrographs, spectra or curves accompany the table — the phase columns are the only indication of which phases were probed.

observations.observation: The figure is a table headed 'Table 6 – EDS for Al and Mn in 9Al-10Mn-1C tempered at 800 °C.', with the unit row given as 'wt%' and two element blocks, Al and Mn, each subdivided into three phase columns labelled δ, γ and k.
Al contents (Min/Mean/Max, wt%) are δ 8.1/8.4/8.7, γ 6.8/7.4/8.7 and k 8.6/9.4/10.0.
Mean Al is lowest in γ (7.4 wt%) and highest in k (9.4 wt%), with δ intermediate at 8.4 wt%.
Mean Mn is lowest in δ (8.3 wt%) and highest in k (12.3 wt%), with γ at 11.4 wt%.
The Min-to-Max spread for every element/phase combination is small, at most 1.9 wt% (Mn in k, 10.1-13.8 wt%), indicating limited measurement scatter.
The caption states the table is EDS data for Al and Mn in 9Al-10Mn-1C steel tempered at 800 °C.
The caption labels the three analysed phases only as δ, γ and k; no crystallographic identification of these phases is given in the table itself.
